name: fullstack-agent-unified-installer
summary: Run the single-command installer repository (`github.com/jaredrhod/fullstack-agent`) to install and configure all four agent components (Memory Vault, Backtalk Voice, Circuit Visualizer, Bare Hands UI) for Claude Code.
steps: Install Claude Code CLI locally on host system.
Clone or pull `https://github.com/jaredrhod/fullstack-agent` repository.
Run interactive installation command in terminal.
Select desired sub-modules (Memory Vault, Backtalk Voice, Circuit Visualizer, Bare Hands UI) during setup prompts.
Provide local file path to target Obsidian vault directory for memory backend.
jarvis_use: Use fullstack installer pattern to deploy integrated voice, vision, memory, and HUD modules in a single CLI setup.

name: obsidian-markdown-memory-vault
summary: Store assistant operational memory, session state, runbooks, and client context as plain-text Markdown files inside a local Obsidian vault.
steps: Create structured folder taxonomy in local Obsidian directory (e.g. Daily Notes, Dev, Resources, Marketing).
Instruct agent to inspect vault root index file at startup of every conversation.
Write session facts, code updates, and user preferences back to markdown files in real time.
Search and reference historical notes across sessions without context window truncation limits.
jarvis_use: Provide unlimited long-term persistent memory for Jarvis using standard local Markdown files.

name: ai-visualizer-circuit-board-hud
summary: Display animated visual status HUD (`ai-visualizer`) reflecting assistant states (LISTENING, THINKING, SPEAKING, IDLE) with real-time waveform audio reactivity.
steps: Launch HUD web surface or overlay window.
Stream audio input levels to drive audio waveform widget during LISTENING.
Render matrix text scrambling animation during THINKING phase.
Highlight HUD perimeter and circuit lines during SPEAKING state output.
jarvis_use: Give Jarvis a reactive visual screen interface that displays execution status in real time.

name: backtalk-voice-interaction-system
summary: Speech input/output pipeline (`backtalk`) built on Claude SDK allowing continuous verbal interaction without keyboard input.
steps: Capture user speech input via microphone.
Transmit raw audio transcript stream directly to Claude API.
Process query and generate response payload.
Synthesize response speech audio and play back via speakers.
jarvis_use: Enable low-latency voice conversations with Jarvis.

name: claude-code-file-system-operations
summary: Execute direct file operations (read, write, append, refactor) on host filesystem via Claude Code engine.
steps: Inspect target file paths and contents.
Generate diff or updated code contents.
Execute filesystem write operations autonomously.
jarvis_use: Allow Jarvis to modify code files, configuration files, and documentation directly on disk.

name: claude-code-terminal-command-execution
summary: Execute native terminal shell commands on host operating system to complete tasks.
steps: Construct bash terminal command payload.
Execute command via local shell process.
Parse stdout/stderr return logs to verify success or debug errors.
jarvis_use: Grant Jarvis system terminal access to run builds, tests, and administrative scripts.

name: claude-code-web-search
summary: Perform automated live internet searches when context or documentation is missing locally.
steps: Detect missing knowledge or API context during request processing.
Issue web search query.
Parse search results and extract relevant web page content into working memory.
jarvis_use: Fetch up-to-date documentation and online answers automatically.

name: parallel-subagent-dispatch
summary: Fork concurrent child sub-agent processes to execute parallel background sub-tasks without interrupting primary user session.
steps: Decompose task into independent parallel work items.
Spawn child worker agent instances.
Assign distinct task scopes to each sub-agent instance.
Aggregate results from completed worker agents back into main agent context.
jarvis_use: Dispatch multi-agent swarms to run multi-file edits, web research, and system checks simultaneously.

name: 24-7-system-monitoring-runbook-execution
summary: Monitor background server stack health continuously and automatically execute diagnostic/recovery runbooks when failures occur.
steps: Run background health check loops across local or remote services.
Detect service failure or error response.
Inspect error logs and identify root cause against vault runbooks.
Apply corrective terminal commands or code patches to resolve incident automatically.
jarvis_use: Enable autonomous self-healing monitoring for local server infrastructure.

name: barehands-spatial-gesture-ui-setup
summary: Initialize webcam-based spatial hand tracking (`barehands`) to control floating desktop UI elements without VR glasses or gloves.
steps: Launch `barehands` application window.
Enable standard webcam video stream.
Detect hand keypoint landmarks and gesture gestures via computer vision pipeline.
Render interactive HUD overlay target elements (`J.A.R.V.I.S. ACTIVE`).
jarvis_use: Provide mid-air webcam spatial gesture controls for Jarvis desktop overlays.

name: barehands-window-pinch-drag
summary: Reposition spatial UI windows in mid-air using thumb-and-index finger pinch drag gestures.
steps: Position hand in front of camera over target HUD element.
Pinch thumb and index finger together to lock selection.
Move hand across screen space to translate window coordinates.
Release pinch gesture to place window at desired coordinate.
jarvis_use: Move floating HUD panels and widgets around screen using simple air pinch gestures.

name: barehands-double-pinch-resize-zoom
summary: Scale floating spatial UI windows up or down using two-handed double-pinch gestures.
steps: Perform thumb-index pinch gestures simultaneously with both hands over window bounds.
Spread hands outward to scale window size up.
Bring hands inward toward center to scale window size down.
jarvis_use: Enlarge or shrink floating Jarvis UI panels in mid-air.

name: barehands-3d-spatial-rotation
summary: Rotate spatial windows and 3D hologram models along 3D pitch, yaw, and roll axes using sustained hand pinch rotations.
steps: Pinch and hold spatial element in camera view.
Rotate hand/wrist angle in 3D space.
Apply calculated rotation transform matrix to object render pipeline.
jarvis_use: Rotate 3D models and interface panels in spatial 3D view.

name: barehands-file-system-navigation-overlay
summary: Browse local filesystem folder structures directly through spatial air gesture selection.
steps: Tap HUD directory category node (e.g. `PROPS`).
Render floating transparent glass list of directory contents.
Scroll through file list and pinch-select target file item.
jarvis_use: Visually navigate and open files from host file directory using spatial menus.

name: barehands-3d-glb-model-rendering
summary: Instantiate and render interactive 3D GLB holographic assets inside spatial UI view.
steps: Select target `.glb` 3D model file from spatial file browser (e.g. coin GLB).
Spawn rotating 3D holographic model on screen.
Manipulate scale, position, and orientation using hand gestures.
jarvis_use: Display interactive 3D assets and holographic visual props.

name: barehands-claw-grab-gesture
summary: Target lock and pull distant spatial elements forward using open-claw, fist, and pull gesture sequence.
steps: Form open claw hand shape directed toward distant spatial window element.
Observe element visual shake indicator confirming target lock.
Close hand firmly into a fist.
Pull fist backward toward body to bring element to immediate foreground.
jarvis_use: Grab and expand distant spatial windows or notification panels using claw gesture.

name: barehands-markdown-text-viewer-overlay
summary: Render rendered Markdown documents into transparent 3D glass panel overlays.
steps: Select Markdown file from vault menu.
Render formatted text content onto floating glass panel surface.
Use hand gestures to tilt, move, or resize document panel.
jarvis_use: Read and review memory vault notes or code summaries in mid-air floating glass panels.

name: barehands-window-top-bar-close-tap
summary: Dismiss active spatial window overlays by tapping top control bar with index finger.
steps: Extend index finger toward top control header of active spatial window panel.
Perform forward tap movement.
Close and unmount spatial window overlay.
jarvis_use: Close active HUD windows and file views hands-free.
